Class FundamentalAnswerMapper

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.connector.fundamental.FundamentalAnswerMapper
public final class FundamentalAnswerMapper extends Object
Turns the answers of the three fundamental sources into rows, following one field contract: every stored value has a stated unit, currency, period and share basis. A missing or non-numeric field writes no row, and every value is stored in full units — Eulerpool's share count in millions is multiplied out here, before any check sees it.

The methods are pure, so that they can be tested on answers recorded by the fundamental source probe.

  • Method Details

    • yahoo

      public static FundamentalAnswer yahoo(tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode root, Integer idSecuritycurrency, LocalDateTime fetchedTime)
      Maps Yahoo's quoteSummary with the modules defaultKeyStatistics, financialData and summaryDetail. EPS, book value per listed share and market capitalisation use the major quote currency. Revenue, debt and cash use financialData.financialCurrency, including for foreign listings and ADRs. Revenue per share divides the company revenue by the same listing-equivalent share count used for market capitalisation. The recorded Nestle, Novo Nordisk, Alibaba ADR and AstraZeneca answers document this contract in src/test/resources/fundamental/samples/README.md.
      Parameters:
      root - the whole answer
      idSecuritycurrency - the security the rows belong to
      fetchedTime - when the answer arrived
      Returns:
      the usable answer, or a failed one when the expected root object is missing

    • finnhub

      public static FundamentalAnswer finnhub(tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode root, Integer idSecuritycurrency, String currency, LocalDateTime fetchedTime)
      Maps Finnhub's basic financials (stock/metric?metric=all). The free plan answers for US listings only, whose values are in the currency of the security. The metric object names no period; the fiscal year earnings take the period of the first annual entry of the series block when that entry carries the same value.
      Parameters:
      root - the whole answer
      idSecuritycurrency - the security the rows belong to
      currency - the currency of the security
      fetchedTime - when the answer arrived
      Returns:
      the usable answer, or a failed one when the metric object is missing

    • eulerpool

      public static FundamentalAnswer eulerpool(tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode root, Integer idSecuritycurrency, LocalDateTime fetchedTime)
      Maps Eulerpool's equity/metrics/{ISIN}. The per-share values describe the last fiscal year, whose end is the newest period of the historical array; other.shares is in millions, leverage .netDebt in full units. The net income of the same period becomes evidence of the unit check.
      Parameters:
      root - the whole answer
      idSecuritycurrency - the security the rows belong to
      fetchedTime - when the answer arrived
      Returns:
      the usable answer, or a failed one when the answer is not an object with per-share values
